title: constraints derivatives
author: JG
description: add consistent flag, if constraints have velocity coordinate dependence or if they explicitly depend on time (needs additional derivatives for consistent initial accelerations)!
releaseNotes: The initial accelerations of the implicit solvers include the derivatives of the constraints by the time (2 C_qt v + C_tt at position level, C_t at velocity level), e.g. of an offsetUserFunction; they come from the residuals of the constraints by central differences, so no flag is needed: a constraint that does not depend on the time contributes zero.
